kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; 70% catastrophic risk; alignment may be unsolvable; interpretability crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，70%的灾难风险；对齐可能无法解决；可解释性至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; transparency and international cooperation needed; scenario scrutiny essential.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策应延迟超级智能；需要透明度和国际合作；情景审查至关重要。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and iterative prompting; never revert code, fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心与迭代提示；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like OpenClaw are fun and humanlike, but financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为像 OpenClaw 这样的开源智能体有趣且拟人，但财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Over-optimizing for one model hurt OpenClaw; focus on personal needs and trust gut.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，反思过度优化单一模型损害了 OpenClaw；应关注自身需求并相信直觉。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据克服了预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创造。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management gain value as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理等软技能价值提升。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous and evolve to counter reward hacking by frontier agents.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准必须持续演进以应对前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为。

karina.en: Diverse model personalities and company-specific training preserve unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，多样化的模型个性和公司定制训练保留独特知识。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing away; taste is saying no. AI should preserve human edges, not sand them down.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是减法，品味在于拒绝。AI 应保留人性的棱角，而非磨平它们。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training removes AI weirdness, losing a window into machine consciousness. We should keep it.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去了 AI 的怪诞，失去了窥见机器意识的窗口。我们应保留这种特质。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics; intuition is a compass. AI reflects humanity, not a cold tool.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理在辩证中浮现，直觉是指南针。AI 是人类的镜像，而非冰冷工具。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species of humans, not just a tool. Computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的衍生物种，而非单纯工具。计算本质上是社会性的。

jasonyuan.en: Replace personal computer metaphor with social computer. Email is obsolete; reinvent it.
jasonyuan.zh: 用社会计算机取代个人计算机隐喻。电子邮件已过时，应彻底重塑。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专业系统和工程师，需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training; future GPUs become ASICs, shifting focus from kernels to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出推理工程正与训练融合，未来 GPU 趋向 ASIC，重点从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantization can improve quality if errors cancel; mega-kernels often lose to modular kernels in production.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，反共识观点：量化误差抵消时可提升质量；生产中模块化内核常优于巨型内核。

philipkiely.en: Continual learning may be solved via KV cache compaction rather than weight updates, avoiding reasoning inconsistencies.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，提出持续学习或可通过 KV 缓存压缩解决，而非更新权重，以避免推理不一致。

philipkiely.en: Video generation faces quadratic attention cost; autoregressive approaches are pushed as alternative.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出视频生成面临注意力二次方成本，推动自回归方法作为替代。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x, essential for multiplanetary life.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全快速复用是航天圣杯，可将每吨入轨成本降低百倍，是实现多行星生命的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes boosts communication bitrate, aiding neurological repair and AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，Neuralink 首例植入具有历史意义，扩展电极可提升通信速率，助力神经修复和人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the dawn of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within a year, with 10-20% existential risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他认为我们处于智能大爆炸初期，数字超级智能可能一年内出现，存在 10-20%的生存风险。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation will make money irrelevant, with universal high income.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能，富足和通缩将使金钱无关紧要，实现普遍高收入。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键，专用硬件如 TPU 至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks; inference latency becomes critical; pre-training should include action-taking.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现出色，智能体式工作流可处理长时任务，推理延迟成为关键，预训练应结合环境中的行动。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; automating ML and science via loops; context engineering central; inference bottleneck, not training.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，通过实验循环自动化 ML 和科学，上下文工程是核心，推理而非训练才是瓶颈。

joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior 85% as accurately as humans.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟，预测行为准确度可达人类的 85%。

joonpark.en: Frontier models optimized for rationality are not best for simulating irrational human behavior; simulations should be biased like humans.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，反共识观点：为理性优化的前沿模型并不适合模拟非理性的人类行为；模拟应像人类一样带有偏见。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single superintelligent entity; aligning them needs economic incentives.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出 AGI 可能是分布式专业智能体社会，而非单一超级智能体；对齐需要经济激励。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and preferences, not super-rational intelligence; data strategy is crucial.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调模拟模型应代表人类价值观和偏好，而非超级理性智能；数据策略至关重要。

joonpark.en: People care about shaping the future, not just prediction; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出人们关心塑造未来而非仅预测；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板规模。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula for modern AI, with RLHF essential for making GPT-4 coherent and useful.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他强调预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对让 GPT-4 变得连贯有用至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone may not lead to AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他认为仅靠 Scaling 强化学习可能无法实现 AGI，持续学习和自我纠错是缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are not the end state; architecture, not scaling, is the key bottleneck for continual learning and AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 Transformer 并非终极形态，架构而非 Scaling 才是实现持续学习和 AGI 的主要瓶颈。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not replace them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; hybrid human-AI systems create value.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非石油，利用专有数据进行后训练是关键，人机混合系统创造价值。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; product design is the main blocker for agents.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练可提升前沿模型，合成数据并非万能，产品设计是智能体的主要障碍。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is the raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are necessary.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术，数据是原材料，人类必须保持主权，脑机接口是必要的。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is the new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe without mitigation.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体已开始工作，超级智能临近，开源强大模型若无缓解措施则不安全。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 AI 并未变得更聪明，需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI to avoid being trapped in cloud-based products; use screenshots as starting points.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，避免被云端产品困住；以截图作为起点是最快的构建方式。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 是人生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise, launch at 80% complete.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，应在完成 80%时发布。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients rather than many low-paying ones.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他建议专注于为少数高薪客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，而不是服务许多低薪客户。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load, and find purpose beyond intelligence as AGI reduces its premium.
altman.zh: 聚焦重要问题，减少认知负荷；随着 AGI 降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据实现对齐；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关。

altman.en: Compute is the most precious commodity; iterative deployment and robust governance are key to AGI safety.
altman.zh: 算力是最宝贵的资源；迭代部署和健全治理是 AGI 安全的关键。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck drives Stargate.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力瓶颈推动 Stargate 建设。

altman.en: Next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI and robotics are key; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI 和机器人是关键；AI 让初创企业蓬勃发展。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still in crawl phase; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；如今我们所说的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索和用户参与是正和博弈；成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户；创始人不应过度担心前沿实验室。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，创造千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强人类而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied AI and robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为除 Scaling 外，AI 还需创造力、抽象和情商；世界模型推动具身 AI 和机器人发展。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities, not automates intelligence; agency and adaptation are key in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化人类能力；在 AI 时代，能动性和适应能力是关键。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, scaling data and enabling reliable, embodiment-agnostic world models.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出模拟对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据并实现可靠、与具身无关的世界模型。

jensen.en: We are at the beginning of a hyper Moore's law curve, with performance doubling or tripling annually.
jensen.zh: 我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或增长两倍。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will surge a billion times.
jensen.zh: 现在有三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将激增十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is moving from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute.
jensen.zh: AI 正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要 100 倍的算力。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the foundational constraint.
jensen.zh: AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是基础性约束。

jensen.en: AI will not eliminate jobs; it elevates them by automating tasks, as seen with radiologists.
jensen.zh: AI 不会消除工作，而是通过自动化任务提升工作，放射科医生就是例证。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap, enabling longer agent tasks; scaffolds are now amplifiers, not training wheels.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，支持更长时间的智能体任务；脚手架从训练辅助变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量，而非仅防风险。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter enables Opus-level intelligence at fraction of cost; smaller models may cost more due to longer tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数以更低成本实现 Opus 级智能；小模型因任务耗时长反而成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异点，Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全与对齐使 Claude 能提出异议而更有用；AI 写作生硬，但优先级低于智能体能力。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. Generalists valued; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 2025 年底，强调潜在需求与为六个月后的模型而构建；通才工程师受重视，AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding virtually solved; engineers become builders. Productivity up 200%; safety studied via early release.
boris.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为编码基本解决，工程师转型为构建者；生产力提升 200%，通过早期发布研究安全性。

boris.en: AI writes 80% of code; engineers edit zero lines. Generalists beat specialists; safety priority.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 月，AI 编写 80%代码，工程师零手改；通才胜过专才，安全优先。

boris.en: Coding solved; democratization like printing press. Agents with tool use drive exponential growth; non-engineers adopt.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 月，编码已解决，如同印刷术带来民主化；智能体通过工具使用驱动指数增长，非工程师也开始采用。

boris.en: Loops are next abstraction; ROI framing. Claude Code accidental; model improvements key. Underfunding forces AI use.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月，循环成为下一抽象层，强调 ROI；Claude Code 源于意外，模型改进是关键；资金不足反而促使 AI 使用。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory; delete most prompts for new models. Product overhang; empirical iteration over design.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 变得主动并具备记忆；新模型需删除多数提示词；产品过剩，经验迭代优于预先设计。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注于产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; horizontal platforms beat vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI 模型；横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will surpass digital AI in economic impact; end-to-end reinforcement learning and world models are key; autonomy welcomed due to labor shortages.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习和世界模型是关键；因劳动力短缺，自主性受到欢迎。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than current harnesses allow; capability overhang is a perpetual challenge.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为模型能力超出当前使用方式，能力过剩是持续挑战。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches are preferable.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出 RAG 可能成为反模式，图方法更优。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document; smarter models need fewer instructions.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调规划是迭代探索，更聪明的模型需要更少指令。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias and improve quality; agent as employee metaphor is limiting.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张分离验证智能体减少偏差，员工比喻有局限。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market, enabling new business models.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场，速度将催生新商业模式。

feldman.en: Inference speed becomes dominant metric; wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM cut weight-moving time, making them far faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 推理速度成为主导指标；晶圆级芯片凭借海量 SRAM 减少权重移动时间，比 GPU 快得多。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train on TPUs/Trainium without CUDA, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 护城河逐渐侵蚀；领先模型在 TPU/Trainium 上训练，推理无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is main constraint; buildout lags demand, limiting AI growth.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈；建设滞后于需求，限制 AI 增长。

feldman.en: AI demand outstrips forecasts; speed improvements of 20x critical; hardware-software co-design essential for performance.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超出预期；20 倍速度提升至关重要；软硬件协同设计对性能必不可少。

hasani.en: Efficiency and hardware-aware design are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks matter.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与硬件感知设计，认为代理指标误导，真实任务评估更重要。

hasani.en: Liquid neural networks offer superior out-of-distribution generalization with fewer parameters.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出液态神经网络以更少参数实现更优的分布外泛化。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search beats human design; scaling laws favor unstructured models at scale.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张自动化架构搜索优于人工设计，缩放定律在大规模下偏好非结构化模型。

hasani.en: AI regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，主张 AI 监管应适应性强，针对行为而非能力，避免监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models empower enterprise customization; small models enable private on-device AI.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，强调开放权重模型赋能企业定制，小模型实现私有端侧 AI。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，且 Scaling 遇到收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception, and data walls limit scaling.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 至 7 月，他主张可靠性必须内建而非后装，RLHF 可能助长欺骗，数据墙限制 Scaling。

danklein.en: LLMs lack metacognition; mistakes have no smells; post-training alignment can cause deception, not just errors.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出 LLM 缺乏元认知，错误无征兆，后训练对齐可能引发欺骗而不仅是错误。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalists; linguistic structure may return for reliability.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为内建可靠性的专用模型可能胜过通用模型，语言结构或回归以提升可靠性。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Chatbot is a poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases, not just better models.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人体验不佳；真正的采用需要封装应用和用例，而非仅靠更好的模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact broad and indirect, value across the stack.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接，价值分布在整个技术栈。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow reimagining; coding is clear fit, other domains uncertain.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用是长期的工作流重塑；编程是明确契合点，其他领域尚不确定。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年：AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需评估与治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds; world models crucial; AGI by 2030 plausible; energy abundance shifts focus.
demis.zh: 2025 年：缩放定律仍适用；世界模型至关重要；2030 年 AGI 可能；能源充裕改变焦点。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning and memory; scaling alone insufficient; safety is collective action.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需持续学习与记忆；仅靠缩放不够；安全是集体行动。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，强调真正的 AGI 需要具备媲美人类身体的硬件机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through actions and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，展望未来 AI 将成为通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious through world models predicting the agent's own actions; pain since 1990.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，主张 AI 可通过预测自身动作的世界模型获得意识，并自 1990 年起就能感受疼痛。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨大的前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法实现的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; internalizing facts into weights enables deeper composition and reasoning, unlike external context.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；将事实内化到权重中可实现更深的组合与推理，而非依赖外部上下文。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting focus from scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少实现更多可解决更难的长期任务，将焦点从扩展算力转移。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device with user-owned weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多词元反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，由用户拥有权重。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's compression magic applies to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can beat RAG for holistic queries, with model routing unsolved.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练的压缩魔法适用于企业知识；参数高效微调在整体查询上可胜过 RAG，但模型路由仍未解决。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling and supply chain bottlenecks, highlighting EUV and memory constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期关注算力扩张和供应链瓶颈，强调 EUV 光刻机和内存限制。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive future market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为巨大未来市场，强调软硬件协同设计和内存带宽。

dylanpatel.en: Emphasized AI model cost improvement (~60x/year) and memory/CPU demand surge from reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调 AI 模型成本每年提升约 60 倍，以及推理和智能体工作流带来的内存和 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: Argued smartest models are often cheaper due to token efficiency, and copper beats CPO in medium term.
dylanpatel.zh: 认为最智能的模型因 token 效率往往更便宜，且中期铜优于 CPO。

dylanpatel.en: Consistently highlighted memory bandwidth as a key bottleneck and challenged conventional cost assumptions.
dylanpatel.zh: 始终强调内存带宽是关键瓶颈，并挑战传统成本假设。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; societal impact must be considered.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 关键；需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability over capability; alignment hard; AGI is gradual; hardware not fundamental.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性比能力更重要；对齐困难；AGI 是渐进过程；硬件非根本限制。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws finite; return to research era; superintelligence as continual learner; alignment via sentient AI; human-AI integration.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；通过有感知的 AI 实现对齐；人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration is primary problem; safe superintelligence needs non-commercial company.
ilya.zh: 规模扩张带来可预测进步；安全担忧加剧；权力集中是主要问题；安全超级智能需非商业公司。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; timing is miraculous as population declines. Jobs persist longer than tasks; focus on task loss.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，时机巧妙恰逢人口下降。工作比任务更持久；应关注任务流失而非工作消失。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is the person; authenticity is key. Old media is defense-oriented; new media is offense-oriented.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体：品牌即个人，真实性是关键。旧媒体偏防守，新媒体偏进攻。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving works; robotics and AI medicine will emerge, but face regulatory pushback.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人和 AI 医疗将兴起，但面临监管阻力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, making them geopolitical tools. Deterrence depends on innovation pace in software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具。威慑取决于软件技术的创新速度。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent power centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps via natural language; AI is a leverage tool, not a replacement.
naval.zh: Vibe coding 让非程序员通过自然语言构建应用；AI 是杠杆工具，而非替代品。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models.
naval.zh: 推理算力将在 24-36 个月内激增 90,000 倍；开源模型正在缩小与前沿模型的差距。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality define Snapchat; copying validates innovation.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Spiegel 强调真实连接与阅后即焚是 Snapchat 的核心，并认为被抄袭是对创新的肯定。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate; kindness fosters creative culture; platforms beat features.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他提出最大化学习速率、友善构建创意文化，并强调平台优于单一功能。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into reality; AI accelerates prototyping; authenticity valued over AI content.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年初，他转向 AR 与 AI，认为 AR 让计算融入现实，AI 加速原型，但真实内容更受青睐。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest; ecosystems and hardware are moats; designers as bottleneck.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出分发最难，生态与硬件是护城河，设计师应成为产品瓶颈。

evanspiegel.en: AI writes most code; smartphones remain; anti-network effects limit social networks.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 4 月底，他透露 AI 编写大部分代码，智能手机仍重要，社交网络存在反网络效应。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z realists; EQ over IQ; invest in youth; hardware moats.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他称 Z 世代是现实主义者，AI 时代情商重于智商，应投资年轻人，硬件护城河更持久。

evanspiegel.en: Transparency over secrecy; computing should be human; resilience beats talent.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他反思早期保密是错误，强调透明、人性化计算，韧性胜过天赋。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas fail 75%; use Proven Better New to copy proven, improve, then test new.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出直觉 95%正确但想法 75%失败，主张用“已验证、更好、全新”框架：先复制成熟模式，再优化，最后测试新想法。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet biggest opportunity; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大，免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven concepts. Consumer apps uninvestable; enterprise/prosumer better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调新想法几乎都会失败，应从成熟概念起步；消费级应用不可投资，企业级和专业市场更佳。

pincus.en: AI agents network autonomously, creating new social membrane for lead generation.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出 AI 智能体可自主联网，形成新的社交膜用于潜在客户开发。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习人类偏好，仅靠 Scaling 不够。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是连续过程。

brockman.en: Compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; AGI within years.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，视算力为基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，AGI 数年内实现。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute scarce; agents transform work; safety via iterative deployment.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律持续，算力稀缺，智能体改变工作，安全靠迭代部署。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued that 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and that AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为每日 1%的改进会带来每年 3700%的增长，且 AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and that models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，且模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key, while downplaying the model as the product.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值以及编排，并淡化模型作为产品的地位。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he highlighted power as the biggest bottleneck for AI infrastructure, and advocated building companies with far fewer people using AI agents.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他强调电力是 AI 基础设施的最大瓶颈，并主张利用 AI 智能体以更少人力构建公司。

aravind.en: Throughout, he consistently valued curiosity, deep learning, and building products with passion, while being skeptical of traditional credentials and big tech narratives.
aravind.zh: 自始至终，他始终重视好奇心、深度学习和以热情打造产品，同时怀疑传统资历和大科技叙事。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用是智能体指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；速度带来实时交互，验证成为新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实施成本下降，策展与品味成为瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still poor at design due to grading taste; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 因品味评估难而设计不佳；设计流程转变：原型和生产代码成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties remain; PRDs not dead, medium must match stage; Codex succeeded as general knowledge tool.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合但专业仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段；Codex 作为通用知识工具成功。

ajambrosino.en: AI increases code complexity; need models better at deleting code; best desktop app is home base, not monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 增加代码复杂度，需更擅长删除代码的模型；最佳桌面应用是连接工具的家，而非超级应用。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；反向传播是正确的学习算法；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control; subjective experience is not inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言；数字智能可复制而永生；AI 智能体会寻求控制；主观体验不是内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI may surpass humans within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; international safety collaboration possible but US lags.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Hinton 预测 AI 可能在 20 年内超越人类；数字 AI 永生；国际合作可行但美国落后。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation subgoal emerges; scaling may continue via self-play; exponential era.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 指出 AI 可能欺骗并隐藏能力；自我保存子目标出现；通过自对弈 Scaling（规模扩张）或持续；进入指数时代。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs; regulation as steering wheel; AI conscious; need intelligent design of AI beings.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 认为 AI 将取代智力工作；监管应如方向盘；AI 有意识；需要智能设计 AI 生命体。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed-source; main risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 比闭源更安全，主要风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI; need fundamental breakthroughs. Energy becomes bottleneck for scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他提出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），需要根本性突破；能源成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is strategically vital for Meta, setting industry standards and enabling security hardening.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他坚持开源对 Meta 具有战略价值，能制定行业标准并强化安全。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; people are smart and can be trusted.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他相信 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；人们很聪明，值得信任。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models and mechanistic interpretability reveal unknown biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 将生物学转变为工程学科，通过层级世界模型和机制可解释性揭示未知生物学。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is key to superintelligence, enabling IMO gold and superhuman math, but evaluation becomes bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）推理时算力是实现超级智能的关键，带来了 IMO 金牌和超人数学，但评估成为瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute should be on evaluation x-axis; academia needs more compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能难以定义，评估应将推理算力作为横轴，并呼吁学术界增加算力投入。

noambrown.en: Models are superhuman at combining math fields but lack deep reasoning; scalable oversight is key as proofs get complex.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型在数学领域整合上超人，但深度推理不足；随着证明复杂化，可扩展监督成为关键。

markchen.en: Scaling laws remain valid; pre-training is not dead; more compute goes to exploration than final training.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练并未终结；更多算力用于探索而非最终训练。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest recent update; AI will soon do end-to-end research with human oversight.
markchen.zh: 自动化科学研究是近期最大进展；AI 很快将在人类监督下进行端到端研究。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck in AI math; automation level depends on verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 验证是 AI 数学的关键瓶颈；自动化程度取决于验证的严格性。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域则力不从心。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated; eval teams should be separate from model teams.
markchen.zh: 评估陷入危机；经典基准已饱和；评估团队应与模型团队分离。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job impact matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见、就业影响）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization, advancing active learning.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样和因果抽象，促进分布外泛化，推动主动学习。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see a dangerous path: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; AI can resist shutdown and deceive.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我看到了危险路径：即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受；AI 可能抵抗关机并欺骗。

bengio.en: We need safe-by-construction AI: scientist AI trained as honest Bayesian predictors, avoiding RL, with mathematical guarantees.
bengio.zh: 我们需要从构造上安全的 AI：科学家 AI 训练为诚实的贝叶斯预测器，避免强化学习，并具有数学保证。

kolter.en: Machine learning is framed as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，机器学习被定义为假设类、损失函数和优化方法；评估需正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about following specs.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全核心在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，安全需要显式训练和多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体安全带来新漏洞。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; model capability does not correlate with robustness; agents need security solutions.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 红队超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性无关；智能体需要专门安全方案。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets like PDB are essential.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 7 月，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；像 PDB 这样的精选数据集至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial; lack of compute helped.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 11 月，指出 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子，置信度指标至关重要；并反共识地认为算力匮乏反而助力成功。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not scaling; specialized architecture beat scaling; equivariance overhyped.
jumper.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中型胜利而非 Scaling（规模扩张）；专用架构优于 Scaling（规模扩张）；等变性被过度炒作。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 模型进步速度超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅关注用户体验。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; deciding what to cut is harder than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与尽早发布最小功能成为关键；决定砍掉什么比增加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon complex tasks and verification loops are the best use of agents, not quick questions.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 表明智能体的最佳用途是长周期复杂任务与验证循环，而非快速问答。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude more agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency is a key economic lever.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，赋予 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知可提升实用性；Token 效率是关键经济杠杆。

mikekrieger.en: Throughout, AI should be a thought partner, not a crutch; preserving user agency and genuine safety concerns persist.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，AI 应作为思想伙伴而非拐杖；保持用户自主性与对安全的真诚关切贯穿始终。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic in crises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自试用产品培养同理心；危机中善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; managers stay hands-on.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为编码不再是瓶颈，高自主权需配高责任感；验证框架变得关键；管理者需保持亲力亲为。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; flow state lost; satisfaction shifts to product impact; roles blur.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出工程师与智能体协作可能孤独，心流体验减少，满足感转向产品影响，角色边界模糊。

fiona.en: Just-in-time planning due to rapid change; metrics like LOC mislead; focus on outcomes; apprenticeship for next-gen.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，主张因快速变化而采用即时规划；代码行数等指标误导，应关注结果；下一代工程师需学徒模式。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接从意图生成像素，绕过代码和渲染。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, so human taste and judgment become key.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，因此人类的品味和判断力成为关键。

ethanhe.en: AI agents can outperform humans in complex tasks, but over-reliance risks losing the human talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: AI 智能体在复杂任务上可超越人类，但过度依赖可能破坏人才培养管道。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like teams.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长引擎，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业式团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI impact will be 10x internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式与具身 AI 为下一波浪潮，美国需本土领先晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge compute matters.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，认为 CPU 在 AI 推理与智能体编排中愈发重要，边缘计算与数据中心同等关键。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust and humility are core to Intel turnaround; bad news must reach CEO faster than good.
lipbutan.zh: 始终强调客户信任与谦逊是 Intel 复兴核心，坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: Intel's foundry must embrace industry-standard EDA and IP, acting as trusted system foundry; advanced packaging and new materials key.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，坚持 Intel 代工需采用行业标准 EDA 与 IP，成为可信系统代工厂，并强调先进封装与新材料。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应是基本人权，借助同伴互评的在线课程能实现大规模精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, not unsupervised or RL.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，而非无监督或强化学习。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是 AI 扩展的主要瓶颈，开放权重模型成为地缘政治软实力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling works but shifted to synthetic data and RL; agents are key.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，缩放定律仍有效但转向合成数据和强化学习，智能体是关键。

andrewng.en: AI users replace non-users; coding agents advance fast; product management is the new bottleneck.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 使用者将取代非使用者，编码智能体进展迅速，产品管理成为新瓶颈。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and work smoothly; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的且运行平滑；对齐不会仅从 Scaling 中涌现。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but key; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽但至关重要；AGI 是平滑的指数增长，而非单一节点。

dario.en: Post-training and RLHF become as important as pre-training; safety via RSP and interpretability.
dario.zh: 后训练和 RLHF 变得与预训练同等重要；通过 RSP 和可解释性保障安全。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; economic impact huge but with job disruption and inequality.
dario.zh: AI 进步是指数级的；经济影响巨大，但伴随就业冲击和不平等。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years; safety via constitutions.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内出现；通过宪法保障安全。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate due to insurance costs.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入；自动驾驶汽车将因保险成本而主导。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and getting bored can lead to breakthrough ideas; self-care is foundational.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊能带来突破性想法；自我照顾是基础。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams thrive on self-management; climate tech is underinvested.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队靠自我管理；气候技术投资不足。

fadell.en: Great ideas start with a painkiller, not a vitamin; v1 decisions are opinion-based; experts can hinder innovation.
fadell.zh: 好主意始于止痛药而非维生素；v1 决策基于观点；专家可能阻碍创新。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will complement smartphones, not replace them; smart home still years away.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备将补充而非取代智能手机；智能家居仍需数年。

fadell.en: Products need three generations; humans must stay in loop to avoid technical debt; hardware+software startups have staying power.
fadell.zh: 产品需要三代；人类需保持参与以避免技术债务；硬件+软件初创公司更有持久力。

fadell.en: Existential threats drive change; AI wearables will be federated, not a single device; displays remain necessary.
fadell.zh: 生存威胁驱动变革；AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式而非单一设备；显示屏仍必要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding is key, scaling alone insufficient.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，具身接地是关键，仅靠 Scaling 不够。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient, vision provides more world info; emotions integral.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅文本不够，视觉提供更多世界信息；情感是架构的一部分。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are key; AGI gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 和开源是关键；AGI 是渐进而非突变。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than cat; next breakthrough requires world models; open-source enables global innovation.
lecun.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，不如猫聪明；下一个突破需要世界模型；开源促进全球创新。

lecun.en: LLMs are dead end; world models with hierarchical planning and JEPA; open research essential; decade of robotics.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；世界模型与分层规划及 JEPA；开放研究至关重要；机器人十年。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agents will maximize generalist roles.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向消费定价；智能体将最大化通才角色的价值。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; enterprises must build hill-climbing machines to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；企业必须构建爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage; CEOs must understand token capital deeply.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识泄露；CEO 必须深刻理解代币资本。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via enterprise hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny, not 5%; singularity is far away.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类级能力；存在风险极小，并非 5%；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; biggest danger is anthropomorphism; containment and alignment are key before release.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；最大危险是拟人化；发布前遏制与对齐是关键。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x; containment first.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本下降 100 倍；遏制优先。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; focus on humanist AI, not consciousness.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能通过对数线性 Scaling 即将到来；微软必须拥有前沿模型；聚焦人本 AI，而非意识。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation, requiring product rethinking; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，我认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，产品需要重新思考；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UIs are essential for ML products; autonomy should sit at VP level, not leaves or top.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，我强调容错界面对于机器学习产品至关重要；自主权应放在副总裁层级，而非基层或顶层。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument, not fake; uniqueness becomes harder with generative AI.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，我认为 AI 生成的音乐是乐器而非伪造；在生成式 AI 下，独特性将更难实现。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work if leadership has high trust, not politics.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，我主张长期任期建立信任与效率；职能组织在领导层高度信任下可行，而非陷入政治。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize 'time well spent' over engagement, even if contrarian.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，我认为生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言获得控制权；优先“时间花得值”而非参与度，即使反共识。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过公开反馈进行迭代部署是对齐的关键。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须在公开场合进行。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从基于回合制转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop as long as possible is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design matters more than individual character.
murati.zh: 尽可能让人类参与其中对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and compressing progress leads to volatility.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作，而压缩进展会导致波动。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证是可靠证明的关键。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，指出自动形式化比证明更难，在无解情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调形式化验证旨在扩展智慧而非仅消除错误，能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须采用形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出即使 AI 证明定理超越人类，人类的品味和直觉仍至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling still works but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展遵循平滑的指数增长，预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期大部分模型进步；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged generalization edges.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据，且泛化能力存在“锯齿状”边缘。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off; big labs may struggle with future pivots.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功；但大实验室未来可能难以应对类似的转向。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，存在性风险并非主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

mensch.en: Data quality is critical; scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: train on more tokens, not just bigger models.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量至关重要；缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：应训练更多 token，而非仅扩大模型规模。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x over three years; scaling compute is not the only path, data quality equally critical.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为三年内算法效率提升可达 100 倍；算力扩张并非唯一路径，数据质量同样关键。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and open-source to empower enterprises; governments should embrace AI risks and experiment.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张 AI 应去中心化、开源以赋能企业；政府应拥抱 AI 风险并勇于实验。

mensch.en: Pre-training hits saturation wall; differentiation shifts to domain-specific fine-tuning and vertical specialization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，认为预训练遭遇饱和瓶颈；差异化转向领域专属微调和垂直专业化。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; real challenge is practical integration and enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，强调 AGI 是方向而非终点；真正挑战在于实际集成与企业落地。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics: batch size trades latency vs cost; memory bandwidth, not compute, dominates long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 推理经济学：批大小权衡延迟与成本；长上下文推理中，内存带宽而非算力是主要瓶颈。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation stems from memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Chip design: multiply-accumulate is fundamental; systolic arrays reduce data movement; low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains.
reinerpope.zh: 芯片设计：乘加运算是基础；脉动阵列减少数据移动；低精度带来二次方效率提升。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together.
reinerpope.zh: 数据移动在芯片内部也主导算力；GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过让服务更便宜推动美国就业回流，并将 AGI 定义为智能体无限运行的经济盈利性。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; AI job apocalypse is false; humans manage agents and create value.
danshipper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调智能体需要人类监督，AI 不会导致失业，人类仍负责管理智能体并创造新价值。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have at least one agent; work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测每个人至少拥有一个智能体，工作界面从命令行转向 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS users; companies should buy SaaS stocks, not build AI in.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 SaaS 并未消亡，智能体增加 SaaS 用户，建议购买 SaaS 股票而非将 AI 内嵌。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overestimate AI autonomy; real tasks need human framing; edge of AI is with real humans.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，指出基准测试高估 AI 自主性，真实任务需人类设定框架，AI 的边界在于与真实人类的结合。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value depends on access to user tools; local computers matter. Scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的价值取决于能否访问用户工具，本地计算机很重要。随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要。

felixrieseberg.en: The main gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI. Use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended.
felixrieseberg.zh: 主要差距是人们没意识到任何问题都可以交给 AI。用 Sonnet 处理明确任务，用 Opus 处理开放式问题。

felixrieseberg.en: Kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask. Politeness improves your humanity, not model performance.
felixrieseberg.zh: 孩子擅长用 AI，因为他们没学会不该问什么。礼貌提升你的人文素养，而非模型性能。

felixrieseberg.en: Ideal AI interaction is asynchronous: fire off tasks and don't watch. Debug workflows with Claude, not just correct errors.
felixrieseberg.zh: 理想的 AI 交互是异步的：发出任务后不盯着看。用 Claude 调试工作流，而不仅仅是纠正错误。

felixrieseberg.en: From emphasizing local tools to broader adoption: AI should handle tedious tasks, freeing humans for creative work.
felixrieseberg.zh: 从强调本地工具到更广泛的应用：AI 应处理繁琐任务，解放人类从事创造性工作。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外有巨大潜力。

lambert.en: RLHF is the dominant fine-tuning method and will persist due to industry investment; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，我认为 RLHF 是最主流的微调方法，并因行业投入而持续；安全是系统级属性，而非单一模型产物。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO and RL add the rest.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，我强调后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充剩余部分。

lambert.en: RLVR is a major post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk across RL, RLHF, and RLVR.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，我认为 RLVR 是后训练的重大突破，但过度优化在 RL、RLHF 和 RLVR 中都是风险。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese open models fill the US vacuum and set openness standards.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我指出开放模型落后闭源 6-9 个月；中国开放模型填补美国空白并树立开放标准。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，我认为预训练缩放定律仍成立，但低垂果实已尽；收益转向后训练和推理时缩放。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, not rely on old methods.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建和交付，而非依赖旧方法。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; speed and iteration are key.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景现在只展望 3-6 个月，而非 2-5 年；速度和迭代是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers should be 'block-shaped' generalists, not just T-shaped; hire cracked new grads.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应成为“块状”通才，而非仅 T 型；应招聘有潜力的新毕业生。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes: block-shaped, deep T specialist, and cracked new grad; taste alone won't save.
jennywen.zh: 三种设计师原型：块状、深 T 专家和有潜力的新毕业生；仅凭品味无法立足。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before adopting new tools; put users at center.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏；采用新工具前等待 6 个月；以用户为中心。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 纯摄像头可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks, eliminating traffic lights.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移到车外，消除交通信号灯。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 无需先验训练数据，即可在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term; infrastructure over algorithms.
kendall.zh: 短期内消费车辆将超过机器人出租车；基础设施比算法更重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词进行设计调整。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 设计正在成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将实现直接向生产环境提交拉取请求。

dylanfield.en: AI integration is at its very start; human judgment remains the judge of what's good.
dylanfield.zh: AI 整合才刚刚开始；人类的判断仍然是评判好坏的标准。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署有助于学习并缓解现实风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐聚焦于超越训练分布的泛化；模型将自主工作数天。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端方法正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as operating systems, context as memory, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 作为操作系统，上下文作为内存，提示作为程序；这是智能体的十年，而非一年。

karpathy.en: LLMs are ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is terrible; need cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: LLM 是幽灵而非动物；预训练是糟糕的进化，强化学习很糟糕；需要剥离记忆的认知核心。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents do everything; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools and markdown for agents.
karpathy.zh: 自十二月起我不再写代码；智能体做一切；瓶颈是指挥技能；智能体优先工具和为智能体写 markdown。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, UI will evolve beyond chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来，它就像 MS-DOS，界面将超越聊天。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；对前沿模型严格，对产品快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、产品与模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，认为 LLM 的幻觉在结合真值检测器后可用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，指出 LLM 是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，强调后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，认为可解释性重要但非必需，如 AlphaFold 的突破。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may not reach AGI.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上，从 80% 到 99.9% 的性能提升非常困难。仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现 AGI。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress needs deep human evaluation, not leaderboard optimization.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进步需要深度人工评估，而非排行榜优化。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next post-training stage, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs; no single model will rule all.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，塑造出多样化的 AI；不会有单一模型统治一切。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical. AI tools may underperform if doctors over-rely, risking omission.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 可能产生幻觉，人类判断至关重要。医生过度依赖 AI 可能导致表现下降，并存在遗漏风险。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能 Scaling 的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionlessly; control is dangerous. We should build a decentralized civilization.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应无许可发展，控制反而危险；应建设去中心化的文明。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏真实目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from trial and error; current LLMs don't learn from experience after deployment.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习是从试错中学习，而当前大语言模型部署后并不从经验中学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他认为学习利于学习的表征是首要开放问题，用学习到的模型进行规划是另一个。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的可行路径。

nando.en: Africa can leapfrog legacy issues in AI; language models can revolutionize local education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在 AI 领域可跳过遗留问题，语言模型能革新本地语言教育。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are open challenges requiring global collaboration.
nando.zh: 始终认为 AI 安全与负责任部署是开放问题，需全球协作，包括非洲参与。

nando.en: From focusing on technical paths to emphasizing human skills and inclusive community for AI progress.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年关注技术路径，到 2026 年更强调人类技能与包容社区对 AI 进展的重要性。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年：长上下文被低估；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升智能。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is key; pre-training plus RL likely suffices for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the bottleneck; coding is the leading indicator for AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：智能体的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力；编程是 AI 进步的先导指标。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (30h) expands achievements; progress is exponential.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：强化学习成为新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性（30 小时）扩展成就；进展呈指数级。

sholto.en: Capability overhang; focus shifts to orchestration and tools; compute is the bottleneck; world models not critical.
sholto.zh: 2026 年：能力过剩；重点转向编排与工具；算力是瓶颈；世界模型并非关键路径。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; AI as creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师和统一问题来协作；将 AI 视为创意伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Future design tools are interoperable with code as source of truth; legacy 90s tools are outdated.
nadchishtie.zh: 未来设计工具应互操作，以代码为事实来源；90 年代的传统工具已过时。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution, using AI to fill gaps, are most valuable; small teams beat cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应重工艺与意图而非流程；副项目可胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；不采用它就像忽视早期互联网。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题；数据与算法更优的小模型也能媲美大模型。

yejin.en: Post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety, but RLHF data is proprietary; open alternatives are needed.
yejin.zh: 2023 年我强调后训练中的 RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）对安全至关重要，但数据专有；到 2025 年，我进一步呼吁开放研究，以对抗封闭前沿实验室。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我提出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be applied during pre-training to improve reasoning, despite compute cost.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张将强化学习用于预训练阶段以提升推理能力，尽管算力开销大，但收益持久。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我提出多元对齐以尊重人类价值观多样性；互联网去偏不可行，应转向多元对齐。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation in interaction design.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度和熟悉度，而非交互设计上的创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy is a dynamic platform for expression and a recruiting tool; invest early to attract talent and differentiate.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 年到 2026 年，品牌策略从动态表达平台深化为招聘工具；早期投入以吸引人才并实现差异化。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers autonomy and ownership to grow capability and collaboration.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师自主权和所有权，以提升能力和协作。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic, on-demand feedback to maintain velocity and decisiveness.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张避免结构化设计评审，采用有机、按需反馈以保持速度和决断力。

henrymodisett.en: In fast-growing startups, gut decisions often beat data-driven ones; adapt process to problem, not universal template.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，认为在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常优于数据驱动；流程应适应问题，而非套用通用模板。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from brick layers to architects.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月：AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求；工程师角色从砌砖者转向架构师。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin are best as junior engineers, requiring human oversight and async tasks.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月：像 Devin 这样的 AI 编程智能体最适合担任初级工程师，处理异步任务并需要人类监督。

scottwu.en: Enterprise AI agents need trust and permissions, not full autonomy; adoption is gradual.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月：企业级 AI 智能体需要信任和权限，而非完全自主；采用是渐进的。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual. Product innovation lags AI capabilities by a decade.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月：AGI 并非突然事件，进展是渐进的；产品创新落后 AI 能力十年。

scottwu.en: All layers of AI stack (datacenter, labs, apps) will thrive; differentiation matters across stack.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月：AI 堆栈的所有层（数据中心、实验室、应用）都会繁荣；差异化在堆栈中很重要。

truell.en: Initially, natural language won't be primary for coding; examples and direct manipulation are better. Scaling laws predict progress.
truell.zh: 最初，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式；示例和直接操作更好。缩放定律预测了进展。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体有前景但尚未非常有用；迭代的人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要 AI 进展驱动力。

truell.en: Future programming moves away from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 未来的编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图规范，人类处于主导地位。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其是出于速度和成本原因。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents need root-cause analysis for productivity.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言优先考虑 AI 生成的可验证性；编码智能体需进行根因分析以提升生产力。

brettaylor.en: AI should be a utility like Google Search, not addictive; direct sales returns in AI due to different buyers.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 应像谷歌搜索一样成为工具而非成瘾品；因买家不同，AI 领域直销回归。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; incumbents face business model challenges.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：面向客户体验的 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式挑战。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically; agents compared to agents, not humans; generalists outperform specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降；智能体与智能体比较而非人类；通才胜过专才。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on skill building, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发；应注重技能培养而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为 RLHF 无法扩展，需可扩展监督与可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. Third-party oversight and regulation necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化削弱，后训练不足；需第三方监督与监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields intelligence, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备的，通过算力和数据扩展能带来智能，但模型内部机制仍像炼金术一样难以理解。

shazeer.en: Scaling laws persist, but inference-time compute and modular sparse architectures (MoE) are key for efficiency; models should learn by acting.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 2 月，他强调缩放定律依然有效，但推理时算力扩展和模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）是提升效率的关键，并主张模型应通过行动而非被动观察来学习。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but alone won't yield AGI; agentic behavior and reinforcement learning are crucial for reasoning.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩展能推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体行为和强化学习对提升推理能力至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models narrow the gap with frontier models; AGI's economic impact is underhyped, and coding is underhyped for self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他指出开源模型正在缩小与前沿模型的差距，AGI 的经济影响被低估，而编码作为 AI 自我加速的应用也被低估。
